profile.headline: Software Engineer in Test II @ Beyond Finance
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer in Test with a proven background in test automation and software development. Proficient in Python and experienced in creating Python scripts to gather data and enhance productivity. Skilled in developing automated tests, utilizing frameworks like Robot Framework, and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines. Strong problem-solving abilities and a solid foundation in computer science. Holds a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science with a Minor in Electronics and Computer Engineering Technology.

positions.title: Software Quality Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop Python applications to gather data from software applications like Oracle PLM, Jira, and qTest to provide insights into game quality and staff productivity metrics.
• Maintain and develop fixes for an internal Flask application that allows users to easily search for game features and jurisdiction specific requirements stored in a database.
• Develop and maintain automated test scripts for the internal Game Development Kit (GDK) using Python and Robot Framework.
• Assist in the integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.

positions.title: Associate Software Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and executed comprehensive test plans and test cases to ensure the quality of game releases and compliance with gaming regulations.
• Identified, documented, and tracked game defects using qTest and Jira.
• Collaborated with game developers to reproduce, analyze, and resolve game defects in a timely manner.
• Conducted compatibility testing on new and legacy slot machines to ensure a consistent user experience.
• Controlled external costs by maintaining track record of receiving first submission approval for all games submitted to external labs for regulatory certification and approval.
positions.insights: Software Testing, Software Quality Assurance and +3 skills

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
• Coordinated and managed end-to-end online market research projects for clients, ensuring adherence to project timelines, budgets, and data quality standards.
• Ensured successful project delivery by effectively communicating project needs to internal survey programmers and external sample suppliers.
• Tested internally programmed online surveys to ensure that the content and logic was implemented according to the client’s specifications.
positions.insights: Market Research, Microsoft Excel and +2 skills

positions.title: Project Coordinator
positions.description:
• Assisted project managers in managing relationships with external sample suppliers, negotiating contracts, and communicating project needs to ensure cost effective and timely delivery of online market research projects.
• Developed a Python application that generates cost confirmation emails for each external sample supplier.
